definitions.explanation: The part of the body connecting the head to the shoulders. Used for physical descriptions and neck-related expressions.
Colloquially, {首|くび}になる means to be fired from a job. This usage comes from the old practice of beheading.

examples.japanese: {首|くび}を{長|なが}くして{待|ま}っています。
マフラーを{首|くび}に{巻|ま}きました。
examples.english: I wrapped a scarf around my neck.

notes: {首|くび}を{長|なが}くして{待|ま}つ is an idiom meaning 'to wait eagerly/impatiently'. In business contexts, {首|くび}になる (to be fired) and {首|くび}にする (to fire someone) are common expressions.
